visual_action: The video starts with a shot of Donald Trump in a suit, sitting at a wooden table and looking down at a phone. It then cuts to a still photograph of a younger Donald Trump standing next to Jeffrey Epstein. Both men are looking at the camera.

cast.name: Donald Trump
cast.evidence: Donald Trump is shown in a video clip at the beginning and in a still photograph with Jeffrey Epstein.

cast.name: Jeffrey Epstein
cast.evidence: Jeffrey Epstein appears in a still photograph next to Donald Trump.

on_screen_text.text: i was your starry eyed lover
and the one that you saw.

spoken_summary: A female vocalist sings lyrics that are also displayed on screen: "I was your starry-eyed lover, and the one that you saw."
audio_music: A slow, melancholic song with a female vocalist plays throughout the video. The tone is somber and intimate, used ironically to underscore the political criticism.
editing_pacing: A slow-paced slideshow consisting of one short video clip followed by one still image.
central_claim: The video implies a close and sinister relationship between Donald Trump and Jeffrey Epstein by ironically juxtaposing their photo with a sad song about a lover.
intended_effect: To foster negative sentiment towards Donald Trump by associating him with the convicted sex offender Jeffrey Epstein.
